theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 34 群

items.colloc: cut costs effectively 有效地削減成本 | cut costs significantly 大幅削減開支
items.distinct: reduce expenses 減少支出 | slash prices 大幅降價
ex: The company needs to cut costs to stay competitive.
公司需要削減成本以保持競爭力。
Management decided to cut costs by reducing travel budgets.
管理層決定透過縮減差旅預算來削減成本。
We are looking for ways to cut costs this quarter.
我們正設法在本季削減開支。

items.colloc: cut the grass regularly 定期除草 | finish cutting the grass 完成除草
items.distinct: mow the lawn 割草坪 | trim the hedges 修剪樹籬
ex: Please cut the grass before the client arrives today.
請在客戶今天抵達前把草除掉。
The landscape team will cut the grass on Friday.
景觀團隊將在週五進行除草工作。
You should cut the grass while the weather is nice.
天氣好的時候你應該把草割了。

items.colloc: buy a decorative item 購買裝飾品 | display a decorative item 展示裝飾品
items.distinct: ornament 飾品 | accessory 配件
ex: Every decorative item in the lobby is hand-crafted.
大廳裡的每一件裝飾品都是手工製作的。
She selected a unique decorative item for the office desk.
她為辦公桌挑選了一件獨特的裝飾品。
The store offers a variety of decorative items for events.
這家店提供多種用於活動的裝飾品。

items.colloc: do a good job on something 在某事上表現優異 | expect someone to do a good job 期待某人有良好表現
items.distinct: perform well 表現良好 | succeed in a task 任務成功
ex: You did a good job on the quarterly marketing report.
你在季度行銷報告上的表現很優秀。
The team did a good job despite the tight deadline.
儘管期限緊迫，團隊還是表現得很好。
I know you will do a good job with this project.
我知道你一定能把這個專案做好。

items.colloc: downsize the workforce 裁減員工 | forced to downsize 被迫縮減規模
items.distinct: lay off 解僱 | restructure 重組
ex: The corporation had to downsize due to falling profits.
由於利潤下降，該公司不得不縮減規模。
Many firms downsize to remain profitable in tough markets.
許多公司為了在嚴峻市場中保持獲利而裁員。
Management decided to downsize the department next month.
管理層決定下個月縮減該部門的人力。

items.colloc: draw up a contract 起草合約 | draw up a plan 擬定計畫
items.distinct: draft 起草 | compose 創作
ex: Our legal team will draw up the agreement by tomorrow.
我們的法律團隊將在明天前起草好協議。
We need to draw up a proposal for the client.
我們需要為客戶擬定一份提案。
The committee began to draw up the new safety guidelines.
委員會開始著手擬定新的安全規範。

items.colloc: required to dress formally 被要求穿著正式 | dress formally for the event 為活動正式著裝
items.distinct: wear a suit 穿西裝 | business attire 商務正裝
ex: Employees are expected to dress formally for the meeting.
員工出席會議時應穿著正式服裝。
Please dress formally when meeting with the board members.
與董事會成員會面時，請穿著正式。
The invitation states that guests should dress formally.
邀請函上註明賓客需穿著正式服裝。

items.colloc: be dressed in a suit 穿著西裝 | appear dressed in a suit 以西裝造型現身
items.distinct: wear a suit 穿著西裝 | in a suit 穿著西裝
ex: The executive was dressed in a suit during the presentation.
那位高階主管在簡報時穿著西裝。
All candidates arrived dressed in suits for the interview.
所有應徵者都穿著西裝抵達面試現場。
He is always dressed in a suit when visiting clients.
他拜訪客戶時總是一身西裝打扮。

items.colloc: provide driving directions 提供開車路線 | follow the driving directions 按照開車指引
items.distinct: navigation 導航 | route map 路線圖
ex: Could you send me the driving directions to your office?
你可以把去你辦公室的開車路線寄給我嗎？
The website provides clear driving directions for visitors.
該網站為訪客提供了清晰的開車路線指引。
We lost our way, so we checked the driving directions.
我們迷路了，所以查看了開車路線指引。

items.zh: 環境規範；環境保護條例
items.colloc: comply with environmental regulations 遵守環保法規 | violate environmental regulations 違反環保法規
items.distinct: safety standards 安全標準 | industry laws 產業法規
ex: The factory must follow strict environmental regulations.
該工廠必須遵守嚴格的環境保護法規。
New environmental regulations will affect our production process.
新的環保法規將影響我們的生產流程。
They were fined for failing to meet environmental regulations.
他們因未符合環保法規而被罰款。

items.colloc: extend an invitation to someone 向某人發出邀請 | formally extend an invitation 正式發出邀請
items.distinct: invite 邀請 | send an invitation 發送邀請函
ex: We would like to extend an invitation to the gala.
我們希望能邀請您參加晚宴。
The CEO extended an invitation to the local business leaders.
執行長向當地商業領袖發出了邀請。
Thank you for extending an invitation to your workshop.
感謝您邀請我參加您的工作坊。

items.colloc: fill in for a colleague 代理同事職務 | be asked to fill in for someone 被要求代理某人
items.distinct: replace 取代 | cover for 代理
ex: I will fill in for Sarah while she is on leave.
莎拉休假期間我會代理她的職務。
Can you fill in for me at the staff meeting today?
你今天能代替我參加員工會議嗎？
He was asked to fill in for the manager temporarily.
他被要求暫時代理經理的職務。

items.colloc: fill the container with water 用水裝滿容器 | fill the form with details 在表格中填寫細節
items.distinct: pack 装包 | stuff 塞滿
ex: Fill the boxes with packing peanuts before shipping them.
出貨前先把保麗龍填充物裝滿箱子。
The organizers will fill the hall with eager guests.
主辦單位會讓大廳擠滿熱切的賓客。
Please fill the application form with your personal information.
請在申請表上填寫您的個人資料。

items.colloc: review a financial statement 審閱財務報表 | release a financial statement 公布財務報表
items.distinct: balance sheet 資產負債表 | income statement 損益表
ex: The accountant is reviewing the quarterly financial statement.
會計師正在審核季度財務報表。
Investors analyzed the financial statement before buying shares.
投資者在購買股票前分析了財務報表。
We need to prepare the financial statement by month-end.
我們需要在月底前準備好財務報表。

items.pos: adv. 親身地 | adj. 第一手的
items.colloc: experience something first hand 親身體驗某事 | get first hand information 獲得第一手資訊
items.distinct: directly 直接地 | personally 親自
ex: I witnessed the market change first hand last year.
去年我親眼見證了市場的變化。
He gained first hand experience working in the factory.
他在工廠工作獲得了第一手的經驗。
We need first hand reports from the project site.
我們需要來自專案現場的第一手報告。

items.colloc: create a flow chart 製作流程圖 | understand the flow chart 理解流程圖
items.distinct: diagram 圖表 | graph 圖形
ex: The flow chart explains the new manufacturing process clearly.
該流程圖清楚地說明了新的製造程序。
Please use a flow chart to illustrate the workflow.
請使用流程圖來說明工作流程。
I drew a flow chart to simplify the complex task.
我畫了一張流程圖來簡化這項複雜的任務。

items.colloc: conduct a focus group 進行焦點小組會議 | gather feedback from a focus group 從焦點小組收集回饋
items.distinct: survey 調查 | committee 委員會
ex: We invited customers to join a focus group session.
我們邀請客戶參加焦點小組會議。
The focus group shared valuable feedback on the prototype.
焦點小組對原型產品提供了寶貴意見。
Marketing teams often use focus groups to test products.
行銷團隊常使用焦點小組來測試產品。

items.colloc: focus on the goals 專注於目標 | focus on the results 聚焦於結果
items.distinct: concentrate on 集中於 | emphasize 強調
ex: We should focus on improving our customer service.
我們應該專注於改善客戶服務。
The management team needs to focus on long-term strategy.
管理團隊需要聚焦於長期策略。
Please focus on the main topic during the meeting.
請在會議期間專注於主要議題。

items.colloc: be followed by a Q&A 接著進行問答 | presentation followed by lunch 簡報後用餐
items.distinct: after 在...之後 | subsequent to 隨後
ex: The lecture will be followed by a short discussion.
講座結束後將接著進行簡短討論。
There is a keynote speech followed by a reception.
將有主題演講，隨後是接待會。
The announcement was followed by a round of applause.
公告之後緊接著響起一陣掌聲。

items.pos: phr. 作為改變；換換口味
items.colloc: do something for a change 做點不一樣的事 | try something for a change 嘗試新事物
items.distinct: for once 這一次 | instead 代替
ex: Let us go out for lunch for a change today.
今天我們換個方式，出去吃午餐吧。
He decided to take the train for a change.
為了換個方式，他決定搭火車。
We should try a different approach for a change.
我們應該試試不同的方法來做點改變。
